```sh
vp exec commitlint --from eb31ba363e1b04e931fd3d2a679da1fe1dfafa09 --to HEAD --verbose
```

Root cause for the local miss: Git is configured with `core.hooksPath=.vite-hooks/_`. Entire wrapped the original Vite+ hook as `.vite-hooks/_/commit-msg.pre-entire`, but Vite+’s wrapper derives the hook name from `basename "$0"`, so once renamed it looked for `.vite-hooks/commit-msg.pre-entire` instead of `.vite-hooks/commit-msg` and exited `0`.

I added [.vite-hooks/commit-msg.pre-entire](.vite-hooks/commit-msg.pre-entire) with the same commitlint command, and validated that `.vite-hooks/_/commit-msg` now rejects the old bad message with the same `subject-case` error.
